General/AbstractHistory.cls::SetSource.behavior: records repository name, moniker and details (H1)

General/History.cls::TimeToString.behavior: no end time shows the start only; details show both (H4)

General/History.cls::SourceToString.behavior: n/a unless install; details add moniker and details (H1, H2)

General/History.cls::SuccessToString.behavior: details print the raw status; one line prints Success or the error text, ERROR #00 for an unfinished record (H3, H4)

General/History.cls::ShowColumns.behavior: ten columns in fixed order, through the *ToString formatters (H1d)

General/History.cls::ShowPhases.behavior: phase name, time and result per phase (HB1d)

General/History.cls::DisplayOneRecord.behavior: details of one ID; a missing ID is an error (H5)

General/History.cls::DisplayQueryResult.behavior: namespace and header once, then one line per record (H4f, H6)

General/History.cls::SetHistoryLastPurge.behavior: marks today after a purge, so later commands skip it (P1, P2, P4)
